services.metaDescription: Software quality engineering, test automation, AI solutions, cloud engineering & DevOps, and software development — services by Troventis.
services.label: 01 · services
services.heading: Services
services.intro: Five core disciplines, one standard: software whose quality can be proven. Every engagement starts with the business problem — not the tool.

quality-engineering.title: Software quality engineering
quality-engineering.summary: QA strategy, test architecture, and quality processes for reliable software delivery.
quality-engineering.body: We analyze your delivery pipeline, define measurable quality goals, and anchor quality assurance where it works: early in the process. From test strategy and test architecture through reviews to quality metrics that enable decisions.

test-automation.title: Test automation
test-automation.summary: Maintainable automation for API, web, and integration — anchored in your CI/CD pipeline.
test-automation.body: Automation that builds confidence instead of maintenance burden: clean test architecture, stable API, web, and integration tests, and consistent CI/CD integration. The result is fast, reliable feedback loops for your team.

ai-solutions.title: AI solutions
ai-solutions.summary: AI-powered backend services and quality assurance for AI-based systems.
ai-solutions.body: We build AI-powered services for enterprise applications and bring quality discipline to AI systems: evaluation, testability, and reliable behavior in production — pragmatic and hype-free.

cloud-devops.title: Cloud engineering & DevOps
cloud-devops.summary: CI/CD optimization, cloud-native architectures, and delivery processes that scale.
cloud-devops.body: From CI/CD pipeline optimization to cloud-native quality initiatives: we modernize delivery processes so releases become faster, safer, and repeatable — with infrastructure your team understands and can operate.

software-development.title: Software development
software-development.summary: Senior development for backend services and enterprise platforms — testable from day one.
software-development.body: Development with a quality standard: clean architecture, testability as a design criterion, and code your team can maintain long-term. Ideal for teams looking for reinforcement with a senior perspective.

p: The controller within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is: Syed Ghayyour Ahmed, Troventis, Günter-Vogt-Ring 38, 60437 Frankfurt am Main, Germany. Email: {email}, phone: +49 172 6069684.

This website is deliberately designed to be data-minimal. We do not use tracking cookies, do not embed third-party fonts, and do not use advertising networks. All fonts are served locally by our hosting provider.

This website is hosted by Cloudflare, Inc. (101 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA) via the Cloudflare Pages service. When you visit the website, Cloudflare processes technically necessary data such as IP address, date and time of access, pages accessed, and browser information in order to deliver the website and ensure its security and stability. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in the secure and performant operation of the website). Data transfer to the USA takes place on the basis of the EU Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, under which Cloudflare is certified. Further information: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

We use Cloudflare Web Analytics, a privacy-friendly analytics solution. Cloudflare Web Analytics does not set cookies, does not use fingerprinting, and does not track individual users across websites. Only aggregated, anonymous metrics are collected (e.g. page views, load times). The legal basis is Art. 6 (1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in measuring reach and improving the website).

If you contact us by email or phone, we process the data you provide (e.g. name, email address, content of the inquiry) to handle your request. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1)(b) GDPR insofar as the inquiry serves the initiation or performance of a contract, and otherwise Art. 6 (1)(f) GDPR. The data is deleted as soon as it is no longer required for processing and no statutory retention obligations apply.
This website contains links to external websites (e.g. LinkedIn). When you click such a link, you leave our website; the privacy policy of the respective provider applies.

You have the following rights with regard to your personal data: the right of access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), data portability (Art. 20 GDPR), and objection to processing (Art. 21 GDPR). You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority; the competent authority is the Hessian Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information.
We will update this privacy policy if the website’s features or the legal situation change (e.g. when a contact form is introduced). The current version published on this page applies.

about.metaDescription: Troventis is a founder-led boutique technology consultancy based in Frankfurt am Main, focused on software quality engineering.
about.label: 05 · about
about.heading: About Troventis
about.intro: Troventis is a founder-led boutique technology consultancy based in Frankfurt am Main — founded in 2026 on a simple conviction: software quality is not a promise, it is an outcome you can prove.
story: Behind Troventis are more than ten years of enterprise software quality engineering experience — across international teams, large software landscapes, and projects where reliability is not a nice-to-have.

That experience made a gap visible: many organizations buy consulting at corporate scale and receive junior teams. Troventis inverts that model — deliberately boutique, with senior expertise in every engagement and trusted partners joining as projects grow.
The name is the program: we verify instead of promising. Every delivery is reviewed, tested, and transparently documented.
about.founderBio: Software quality engineer with over ten years of experience in test strategy, test automation, and quality processes for enterprise applications — from telecommunications to the public sector.

values.title: Honesty over revenue
